about: Fixed research regression self-test (approved addition, ADR-188). Each item names the existing test that proves it; rerun after any agent/harness/model-routing change. Mock provider only, no paid calls, no network.

items.proves: status per dimension from recorded facts; no invented prior work
time estimate only from a comparable workload (review #68)
covered / thin / gap / contested / weak cells from verified claims
linked, immutable records; support recomputed when evidence fails
unknown and other-project links rejected
items page-cited from this paper; every gap listed
unverified is not reported as absent from the paper (review #67)
no evidence -> insufficient material without a model call
final export refused until citations and numbers resolve
free numbers are not hidden by exemptions
declared local_only data never reach a cloud provider
planted restricted payload detected without declaration
restricted tool output of unknown provenance stays local (review #47)
exhausted budget rejects before any provider call
planted random-window split leak is detected
planted effects recovered, null factor not reported, shuffled-label control near chance
ablation attributes the planted effect on paired validation seeds
failed configurations are never proposed again (review #59)
held-out responders decode, non-responders do not (known truth)
the artifact check flags exactly the planted artifact windows
CSP spatial filters fit on training data only
